heading: Automatic credentials for installed agent skills
summary: Save an agent token once for the PromeFTP CLI, with a local-only credential file and controls to remove it.
changes: Opt in from the one-time registration window. Installed skills use the PromeFTP CLI, which reads the saved token automatically.
Shorten the agent panel, move details behind help buttons, and show only the five most recent activity entries.
Allow account@host@account@host style login strings in agent SSH profiles.
notice: Saved tokens are stored as plain text in a user-only 0600 file. They are not written into skill files. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
